title: Dear Google: please let me ban sites from results
guide_zh: 用户请求 Google 提供跨浏览器屏蔽指定搜索来源的功能。
author: nervechannel
excerpt: Given the current high-ranking thread about spammy sites in Google results, it strikes me that a very simple solution would be to let logged-in users blacklist sites. Bam, no more wareseeker or efreedom. This would solve a lot of people's complaints in one fell swoop. There are greasemonkey etc. scripts to do this, but they're tied to a single browser on a single machine. A global filter (like in gmail) would be so much more useful. Would this be particularly hard to do?
